## History

Thomas is not directly depicted taking action in the given events, though he exists within the broader context of Anne's past, where she gained life experience caring for children like twins. His background forms part of the foundation that allowed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to step up and successfully treat [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) during a medical crisis.

## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas.md)

Thomas is married to [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), a prominent figure in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who is known for her keen interest in her neighbors' affairs. Though Thomas himself rarely features directly in community events, his household is deeply involved in local gossip and neighborhood discussions, such as the Cuthberts' adoption of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Matthew's declining health.
